category_title: Students exhibiting inappropriate verbal behavior and noise-making in academic contexts
scenario_title: Independent textbook activities with adult initiation
minimal_context: Desi is sitting at his desk working on independent textbook activities.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Desi, it is time to start your independent textbook activities at your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes a loud buzzing noise with his mouth) I don't want to do this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop making noise and look at your book.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Stop telling me what to do! You're always bothering me!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to finish your assignment right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Leave me alone! If you don't go away, I'm going to rip this textbook up!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Desi, it is time to start your independent textbook activities at your desk.

STUDENT: (Makes a loud buzzing noise with his mouth) I don't want to do this.

TUTOR: Please stop making noise and look at your book.

STUDENT: Stop telling me what to do! You're always bothering me!

TUTOR: You need to finish your assignment right now.

STUDENT: Leave me alone! If you don't go away, I'm going to rip this textbook up!

context.environment: Classroom setting for students in elementary school programs for severe emotional disturbance
context.materials: Textbook, tape recorder, sheet of paper at his desk

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Adult initiation or when staff gave the student specific praise less frequently than once every 5 minutes
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: No response or negative verbal or nonverbal response to adult initiation; inappropriate verbal behavior toward staff (arguing, whining, threatening statements)

behavior_patterns.condition: In academic context during independent textbook activities
